briefing.hook: Pernod Ricard sees activity across strategy, brand partnerships, market scrutiny and financial moves.

categories.🤝 Strategy & M&A: Revenue intelligence searches in India spotlight Diageo and Pernod Ricard, while Corby Spirit and Wine Limited questions the sustainability of Pernod Ricard’s generous payouts.
categories.🥃 Spirits & Brands: Jameson revives its Cats on Tap program for the 2026‑27 season, partners with Strahman Group for service provision, and its ambassador Jameson Williams discusses marijuana legality amid NFL changes.
categories.📈 Market: Tax officials in India investigate Pernod Ricard and Diageo over the classification of some bulk Scotch imports.
categories.💡 Innovation & RTD: RBC lifts its target for Pernod Ricard stock, the company launches a tender offer for Seven Notes Series and plans a new subordinated notes issue, while Corby Spirit’s shares rise on sentiment around RTD growth and Pernod Ricard distribution support.
